narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed ahead of a secondary cold front moving across Virginia on August 19. These storms produced damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: The public reported flash flooding near the intersection of Cherry Lane and Talleysville Road. Flooding of yards, ditches, and roadways was reported.
VDOT cameras showed standing water up to one foot deep in the leftmost lane of interstate 95. Multiple cars were pulled off on the shoulder of the roadway.
VDOT reported water covering Mount Olive Cohoke Road.
The 911 call center reported water covering the road in Reedville.
The public reported water covering a section of the road on Stony Run Road before the intersection with Williamsburg Avenue.
An NWS Employee shared a picture showing extensive standing water on a yard with water overflowing across a gravel driveway.
